mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reward (reward_name, reward_amount, reward_price, applied_count, reward_delivery_date, reward_description, project_id, reward_image, reward_image_type) VALUES (#{rewardName}, #{rewardAmount}, #{rewardPrice}, #{appliedCount}, #{rewardDeliveryDate}, #{rewardDescription}, #{projectId}, #{rewardImage}, #{rewardImageType})
mapper.select: SELECT reward_id, project_id, reward_name, reward_description, reward_price, reward_amount, applied_count, reward_delivery_date, reward_image_type, LENGTH(reward_image) AS image_size FROM reward WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY reward_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reward WHERE project_id = #{projectId}
SELECT reward_id, project_id, reward_name, reward_description, reward_price, reward_amount, applied_count, reward_delivery_date, reward_image_type FROM reward WHERE reward_id = #{rewardId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE reward SET applied_count = applied_count + 1 WHERE reward_id = #{rewardId} AND (reward_amount IS NULL OR applied_count < reward_amount)
mapper.select: SELECT r.reward_id, r.project_id, r.reward_name, r.reward_description, r.reward_price, r.reward_amount, r.applied_count, r.reward_delivery_date, r.reward_image_type, LENGTH(r.reward_image) AS image_size, f.user_id AS supporter_id, u.user_name AS supporter_name, u.phone_number AS supporter_phone, s.delivery_address, f.funded_date FROM reward r LEFT JOIN funding f ON f.reward_id = r.reward_id LEFT JOIN supporter s ON s.user_id = f.user_id LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.user_id = f.user_id WHERE r.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY r.reward_id, f.funded_date, f.user_id
